translation: 多年来，人工智能领域的正统观念认为前沿能力只能维持在专有壁垒之后。然而开放权重开发者的崛起彻底颠覆了这一假设。

focusSentence.en: However, the rapid ascent of open-weight model developers has fundamentally disrupted this assumption.
focusSentence.why: 转折副词 However 领起主句，disrupted 一词强化对既有格局的冲击感。

notes.nuance: 暗含被广泛接受但趋于僵化的教条。
强调对既有格局的破坏性重塑。

simplifiedText: For years, the common belief in artificial intelligence held that frontier capabilities could only survive behind private walls. However, the rapid rise of open-weight model developers has fundamentally disrupted this assumption.

replacements.note: 原词 orthodoxy 带僵化教条意味
